mechanisms.owner: execute-milestone.js Audit phase (both .claude/workflows and plugin/workflows mirrors) + composite-audit.ts snapshot/guard mode
mechanisms.rationale: One atomic read-only-Audit safety contract grouping three inseparable call-site variants: (a) per-shard dispatch of one audit-shard-<id> agent per manifest.auditShards[] entry (composite-contracts.ts:44) scoped to taskIds; (b) the workflow's own inline-DSL before/after git-status diff that hard-fails any non-empty delta as audit-shard-write-violation:<id>; (c) stripping the composite CHECKLIST/DISPOSITION/DEVIATION write instructions from the Audit prompt (currently execute-milestone.js:295/298/315). No strict subset ships with a complete safety contract: dispatch without the diff multiplies unenforced writers; the diff without stripping writes fails every audit (the agent writes by design today); stripping writes without a downstream writer (Reconcile/D4) orphans them. Lands as one unit; legacy width-1 Audit is untouched (compatibility oracle / golden replay). Carries audit-cli-modes and shard-verdict-combine as inseparable call-site variants of the same contract.

New non-selftest --snapshot/--guard/--combine-json CLI modes (wrapping the already-exported combineShardVerdicts, L93) exist solely to be invoked from the workflow's dispatch/enforcement/combine prompt text — the DSL has no import capability, so every production callsite is a prompt-text command string (same pattern as composite-preflight.ts at execute-milestone.js:133). With no production importer they are --selftest-only dead code — exactly the state AC1 fails on — so they have no independent shippable value. Distinct proofSurface from readonly-audit-core (the .ts module vs the workflow file).

One audit-combine agent (distinct label, excluded from the shard-count check) invoking the real exported combineShardVerdicts() (composite-audit.ts:93, verified real/exported, today reached only via selftest/tests) to produce the generation-bound BundleAuditResult that the workflow's verdict branch consumes (execute-milestone.js:387-397 read a single auditResult.verdict). combine of <=1 shard is degenerate, so it is REQUIRED by the per-shard dispatch to yield a single consumable verdict and has no independent user value; AC3 falsifies reimplementation via import grep. proofSurface is the real symbol it must wrap, distinct from the other two entries.
